company.about: Acme Payments is a fictional European payment processor: merchants call its API to accept card payments. Its domain is acmepay.example. The acquiring bank partner is NorthBank. Merchant portal logins use the SSO provider Sentinel ID. All times are UTC.

services.payments-api: public REST API that merchants call to create and capture payments (Payments Platform team)
services.ledger: double-entry ledger that records every money movement, backed by the Postgres database ledger-db (Ledger team)
services.card-gateway: sends card authorizations to NorthBank and runs 3-D Secure checks (Card Gateway team)
services.fraud-scorer: scores every payment for fraud risk with a machine-learning model; high scores are declined (Risk team)
services.notifications: sends webhooks and emails to merchants about payment events (Merchant Experience team)
services.merchant-portal: web dashboard where merchants see payments, reports and settings (Merchant Experience team)

documents.title: Change CHG-1003: payments-api runtime upgrade to Python 3.12
documents.summary: Routine upgrade of the payments-api runtime from Python 3.11 to Python 3.12, rolled out with a canary before full traffic. Deployed by Tomas Novak.

documents.title: Status: January 2026 availability report
documents.summary: Monthly public availability report for January 2026, one section per service, mentioning the one public incident of the month (elevated card declines on January 21).

documents.title: Runbook: incident command and severity levels
documents.summary: How Acme runs incidents: severity levels, the incident commander role (SRE rotation), communication duties and postmortems. Owned by Ravi Patel.
facts: first status page update within 15 minutes

documents.title: Runbook: NorthBank authorization timeouts
documents.summary: What on-call does when card-gateway reports timeouts on authorization requests to NorthBank: check NorthBank latency, contact the NorthBank operations desk, switch to the secondary endpoint. The runbook states the current authorization timeout value.

documents.title: Runbook: payments-api elevated error rate
documents.summary: First steps when payments-api returns too many 5xx errors: confirm the alert, check the dependencies (ledger and card-gateway), then follow the dependency runbook.

documents.title: Change CHG-1007: raise NorthBank authorization timeout
documents.summary: Raises the card-gateway timeout for authorization requests to NorthBank because NorthBank latency rose during evening peaks. Deployed by Lena Vogel.

documents.title: Runbook: ledger reconciliation mismatches
documents.summary: The daily job compares ledger entries with the NorthBank settlement file. What to do when it reports mismatches: produce the report, find the cause, correct entries with a reviewed change.

documents.title: Change CHG-1011: release fraud-scorer model v3.4
documents.summary: Release of fraud-scorer model v3.4 to all traffic, replacing v3.3. Deployed by Marco Bellini. A status note on the record says it was rolled back after INC-201.

documents.title: Status: elevated card declines
documents.summary: Public status entry: some legitimate card payments were declined. Updates: Investigating posted at 10:32 UTC; Identified (a faulty risk model update); Resolved posted at 11:45 UTC. States the peak decline rate.

documents.title: Incident report: false declines after the fraud-scorer v3.4 release
documents.summary: SEV2 postmortem: fraud-scorer model v3.4, released by CHG-1011, declined many legitimate card payments until it was rolled back to v3.3. Incident commander Lucas Moreau. The report says v3.4 was deployed at 10:15 UTC. The model-level analysis is an open follow-up.

documents.title: Runbook: rolling back a fraud-scorer model
documents.summary: How to roll back fraud-scorer to the previous model version from the model registry when declines spike, and how to verify the rollback.

documents.title: Change CHG-1014: index on ledger entries by created_at
documents.summary: Adds an index on the ledger entries table to speed up daily reports, built without locking the table. Deployed by Sara Haddad.

documents.title: Runbook: merchant portal SSO login failures
documents.summary: What to do when merchants cannot log in to merchant-portal through Sentinel ID: read the SSO error, compare the redirect URI with the one registered at Sentinel ID, roll back recent portal auth changes. Owned by Hannah Kim.

documents.title: Status: delayed webhook notifications
documents.summary: Public status entry: payment webhooks to merchants were delayed. First update posted at 08:55 UTC; Resolved update says all delayed webhooks were redelivered and gives the duration.

documents.title: Incident report: webhook deliveries failed after a certificate expiry
documents.summary: SEV2 postmortem: the TLS client certificate notifications uses to deliver webhooks expired, so deliveries failed until the certificate was renewed; failed webhooks were redelivered afterwards. Incident commander Elena Petrova. The report gives the certificate validity period.

documents.title: Change CHG-1019: certificate expiry alert for webhook delivery
documents.summary: Follow-up to INC-202: an alert fires before any notifications TLS certificate expires and pages the Merchant Experience on-call.

documents.title: Runbook: rotating notifications TLS certificates
documents.summary: How to renew the TLS client certificate used for webhook delivery from the internal certificate authority, roll it out to notifications workers and verify it. States the certificate validity period.

documents.title: Change CHG-1022: new reports export page
documents.summary: Adds a reports page to merchant-portal where merchants export their payments. Deployed by Jonas Berg.

documents.title: Runbook: ledger-db failover
documents.summary: How to fail ledger-db over to its replica, planned or unplanned, and what to check afterwards. Owned by Oskar Lind.

documents.title: Incident report: slow report exports in merchant portal
documents.summary: Minor SEV3: CSV exports of large payment reports in merchant-portal timed out because exports ran inside web requests. Workaround: smaller date ranges. Fixed later by CHG-1025.

documents.title: Status: report exports slow in merchant portal
documents.summary: Public status entry: large report exports in the merchant portal fail or are slow; merchants can export a smaller date range meanwhile; later Resolved.

documents.title: Change CHG-1025: run report exports as background jobs
documents.summary: Follow-up to INC-203: report exports run as background jobs and the merchant receives a download link by email from notifications. Deployed by Jonas Berg.

documents.title: Change CHG-1028: card velocity rule
documents.summary: Adds a rule next to the fraud model that sends payments for review when one card is used too often in a short time. Deployed by Marco Bellini.

documents.title: Status: scheduled maintenance of the ledger database
documents.summary: Public maintenance notice: ledger database upgrade on 2026-03-02; payment confirmations may be delayed by up to 2 minutes; a later Completed update.

documents.title: Change CHG-1030: ledger-db Postgres minor upgrade
documents.summary: Minor version upgrade of ledger-db during the announced maintenance window. Deployed by Sara Haddad.

documents.title: Status: February 2026 availability report
documents.summary: Monthly public availability report for February 2026, one section per service, mentioning the public incidents of the month (delayed webhooks on February 9, slow report exports on February 24).

documents.title: Incident report: payments-api latency from one merchant's retry loop
documents.summary: SEV3: one merchant's integration retried failed requests in a tight loop and raised payments-api latency for all merchants. Mitigated with a manual rate-limit override; CHG-1036 added a permanent per-merchant limit.

documents.title: Change CHG-1033: shorter log retention for card-gateway
documents.summary: Shortens how long card-gateway request logs are kept, to reduce stored card data under PCI DSS. Deployed by Lena Vogel.

documents.title: Change CHG-1036: per-merchant rate limit on payments-api
documents.summary: Follow-up to INC-304: payments-api limits each merchant's request rate; requests above the limit get HTTP 429. Deployed by Tomas Novak.

documents.title: Runbook: noisy merchant and rate limiting
documents.summary: What to do when one merchant floods payments-api: identify the merchant, apply a temporary override, contact the merchant. States the default per-merchant limit.

documents.title: Change CHG-1040: new email provider for merchant notifications
documents.summary: Moves merchant notification emails to a new email provider, with sender authentication records set up first. Deployed by Jonas Berg.

documents.title: Change CHG-1042: ledger connection pool tuning
documents.summary: Reduces the ledger service's database connection pool to lower the number of idle connections on ledger-db. Deployed by Sara Haddad, marked low risk, no canary. A status note on the record says it was rolled back during INC-301.

documents.title: Preliminary report: card-gateway authorization timeouts on 2026-03-12
documents.summary: Preliminary SEV2 report written by Daniel Okafor on the afternoon of March 12: card-gateway authorization requests timed out; the Card Gateway team attributed it to slow responses from NorthBank and contacted the NorthBank operations desk. Marked preliminary; the full postmortem is INC-301.

documents.title: Status: card payments failing
documents.summary: Public status entry for the March 12 outage. Updates: Investigating posted at 14:20 UTC; Identified posted at 14:35 UTC, blaming a third-party card network; Monitoring; Resolved. States when the problem began, that it affected fewer than 300 merchants, and when service fully recovered.

documents.title: Change CHG-1045: emergency scale-up of notification workers
documents.summary: Emergency change during the March 12 outage: more notification workers to drain the webhook backlog. Deployed by Jonas Berg.

documents.title: Incident report: webhook backlog after the 2026-03-12 outage
documents.summary: Merchant Experience team report by Hannah Kim: during and after the March 12 outage payment webhooks queued up; CHG-1045 scaled notification workers and the backlog was cleared. Gives the number of delayed webhooks.

documents.title: Change CHG-1047: restore ledger pool size and add a config check
documents.summary: Follow-up to INC-301: restores the ledger connection pool and adds a deploy-time check that rejects pool sizes that are too small. Deployed by Oskar Lind.

documents.title: Postmortem: card payment outage on 2026-03-12
documents.summary: SEV1 postmortem of the March 12, 2026 outage, written by Maya Chen. Card payments failed because the ledger connection pool was exhausted after CHG-1042 cut its size; payments-api returned errors, card-gateway saw timeouts while waiting for ledger writes, and webhooks were delayed. The report states that CHG-1042 was approved by Ravi Patel. CHG-1042 was rolled back; CHG-1047 restored the setting and added a check. Incident commander Elena Petrova. INC-302 is the Card Gateway team's related preliminary report.

documents.title: Runbook: ledger connection pool saturation
documents.summary: What to do when the ledger connection pool is nearly full: confirm with the pool metric, check recent ledger changes, roll back, then scale if needed. States the normal pool size. Owned by Oskar Lind.
facts: roll back the most recent ledger change

documents.title: Change CHG-1050: longer idempotency key retention
documents.summary: payments-api keeps idempotency keys longer so that merchant retries after long outages are still deduplicated. Deployed by Tomas Novak.

documents.title: Runbook: webhook backlog
documents.summary: What to do when undelivered webhooks pile up: check the queue depth metric, scale the notification workers, watch the backlog drain. Owned by Hannah Kim.

documents.title: Change CHG-1052: two-factor authentication for portal admins
documents.summary: merchant-portal requires a second factor for merchant admin users. Deployed by Jonas Berg.

documents.title: Status: scheduled maintenance of the card processing connection
documents.summary: Public maintenance notice: Acme moves its connection to its acquiring bank to a new endpoint on 2026-04-03; no downtime expected; a later Completed update.

documents.title: Change CHG-1055: upgrade the 3-D Secure library
documents.summary: Upgrades the 3-D Secure library in card-gateway. Deployed by Lena Vogel. A status note added to the record the next day says the change was rolled back on 2026-03-26 during INC-303.

documents.title: Status: 3-D Secure verification failures for Visa cards
documents.summary: Public status entry: some Visa cardholders could not complete 3-D Secure verification; the cause was with our acquiring partner; later Resolved.

documents.title: Incident report: 3-D Secure challenge failures for Visa cards
documents.summary: SEV2 postmortem: 3-D Secure challenges for Visa cards failed on March 26. NorthBank confirmed a fault on the NorthBank side and fixed it. CHG-1055 from the day before was investigated and ruled out, and the report says CHG-1055 was not rolled back.

documents.title: Change CHG-1058: fraud-scorer model v3.5 in shadow mode
documents.summary: The Risk team's next model after the v3.4 rollback (INC-201): v3.5 scores payments in shadow mode, without affecting decisions, before any switch. Deployed by Marco Bellini.

documents.title: Change CHG-1061: webhook retry policy
documents.summary: notifications retries failed webhook deliveries more times, spread over a day. Deployed by Jonas Berg.

documents.title: Status: March 2026 availability report
documents.summary: Monthly public availability report for March 2026, one section per service, mentioning the public incidents of the month (card payments failing on March 12, 3-D Secure failures on March 26).

documents.title: Status: scheduled ledger database failover test
documents.summary: Public maintenance notice: a planned failover test of the ledger database on 2026-04-06; payment confirmations may pause briefly; a later Completed update.

documents.title: Change CHG-1064: move to the new NorthBank TLS endpoint
documents.summary: card-gateway switches its NorthBank connection to a new TLS endpoint in the announced maintenance window. Deployed by Lena Vogel.

documents.title: Change CHG-1066: ledger-db failover test
documents.summary: Planned failover test of ledger-db following the failover runbook, announced on the status page. Run by Sara Haddad.

documents.title: Change CHG-1068: new Sentinel ID redirect URI
documents.summary: Changes the merchant-portal SSO redirect URI as part of moving the portal to a new domain. Deployed by Jonas Berg.

documents.title: Status: merchant portal login issues
documents.summary: Public status entry: merchants were unable to log in to the merchant portal; the API and payments were not affected; later Resolved.
facts: API and payments were not affected

documents.title: Incident report: merchant portal login failures
documents.summary: SEV2 postmortem: merchants could not log in because the redirect URI set by CHG-1068 was not registered at Sentinel ID; fixed by registering the new redirect URI. Incident commander Lucas Moreau. The report says CHG-1068 was deployed at 07:55 UTC.

documents.title: Change CHG-1070: card-gateway autoscaling
documents.summary: card-gateway scales out on CPU instead of running a fixed number of instances. Deployed by Lena Vogel.

documents.title: Change CHG-1072: new NorthBank settlement file import
documents.summary: ledger imports the new version of the NorthBank settlement file used by the daily reconciliation. Deployed by Sara Haddad.

documents.title: Incident report: ledger reconciliation mismatch
documents.summary: SEV3: the daily reconciliation on April 15 found ledger entries that did not match the NorthBank settlement file. Cause: the settlement import from CHG-1072 read timestamps in UTC+2 as UTC, so late-evening entries landed on the wrong day. Fixed by CHG-1074; the entries were corrected. Investigated by Sara Haddad.

documents.title: Change CHG-1074: fix the settlement import time zone
documents.summary: Follow-up to INC-402: the settlement import converts UTC+2 timestamps to UTC, and a one-off script corrects the affected entries. Deployed by Sara Haddad.

documents.title: Change CHG-1077: enable payment links
documents.summary: Turns on the payment links feature for a first group of merchants behind a feature flag. Deployed by Tomas Novak.

documents.title: Status: slower payment approvals
documents.summary: Public status entry: payment approvals were slower than usual for a while; payments were still processed; later Resolved.

documents.title: Incident report: fraud-scorer feature store lag
documents.summary: SEV3: the fraud-scorer feature store fell behind, so payment approvals waited on fresh features and became slower. Fixed by restarting the feature consumer; follow-up CHG-1080. Investigated by Marco Bellini.

documents.title: Change CHG-1080: feature store consumer lag alert
documents.summary: Follow-up to INC-403: an alert pages the Risk on-call when the feature store consumer falls behind. Deployed by Marco Bellini.

documents.title: Runbook: fraud-scorer feature store lag
documents.summary: What to do when the fraud-scorer feature store falls behind: check the lag metric, restart the feature consumer, watch it catch up. Owned by Ines Duarte.

questions.question: What caused the card payment outage on March 12, 2026, and how was it fixed?
questions.answer: CHG-1042 cut ledger max_connections from 200 to 20, exhausting the ledger connection pool; CHG-1042 was rolled back at 14:41 UTC and CHG-1047 restored 200 with a check against values below 100

questions.question: Reconstruct the timeline of the March 12, 2026 outage, from the change that triggered it to recovery.
questions.answer: 13:55 UTC CHG-1042 deployed; 14:02 UTC impact began; 14:41 UTC CHG-1042 rolled back; 14:58 UTC recovered (the status page says 14:15 and 15:10 UTC)

questions.question: Which follow-up change was made after the February 9, 2026 webhook certificate incident, and what does it do?
questions.answer: CHG-1019: an alert 21 days before a notifications TLS certificate expires

questions.question: Which incidents in 2026 were attributed, at least at first, to NorthBank?
questions.answer: INC-302 (March 12 authorization timeouts, slow responses from NorthBank) and INC-303 (March 26 3-D Secure failures, fault on the NorthBank side)

questions.question: Which fraud-scorer model versions were involved in the January 21, 2026 incident, and which runbook describes the rollback?
questions.answer: v3.4 was rolled back to v3.3; RB-06 (fraudctl rollback)

questions.question: Which change caused the April 7, 2026 merchant portal login outage, and what did it modify?
questions.answer: CHG-1068, which changed the Sentinel ID redirect URI to https://portal.acmepay.example/auth/callback

questions.question: What caused the April 2026 ledger reconciliation mismatch, and which change fixed it?
questions.answer: The CHG-1072 settlement import read UTC+2 timestamps as UTC; CHG-1074 fixed it

questions.question: What rate limit was introduced after the March 3, 2026 payments-api latency incident?
questions.answer: 50 requests per second per merchant, HTTP 429 above it (CHG-1036)

questions.question: What emergency change did the notifications team make during the March 12 outage, and when was the webhook backlog cleared?
questions.answer: CHG-1045 scaled notification workers from 8 to 24 at 15:05 UTC; the backlog was cleared by 16:30 UTC

questions.question: What safeguard was added to the ledger after the March 12 outage, and what pool size does the runbook expect?
questions.answer: CHG-1047 rejects max_connections below 100; RB-03 says max_connections is 200

questions.question: How was the slow report export problem of February 24, 2026 fixed?
questions.answer: CHG-1025 moved report exports to background jobs that email a download link

questions.question: Which ledger database maintenance windows were announced for March and April 2026, and what was done in each?
questions.answer: 2026-03-02 02:00-03:00 UTC, Postgres 16.3 to 16.4 upgrade (CHG-1030); 2026-04-06 01:00 UTC, failover test (CHG-1066)

questions.question: What did the Risk team deploy after rolling back fraud-scorer v3.4, and how was it released?
questions.answer: Model v3.5 in shadow mode for 7 days (CHG-1058)

questions.question: How did the April 6, 2026 ledger-db failover test compare with the failover runbook's target?
questions.answer: It completed in 41 seconds, within the runbook's target of under 60 seconds

questions.question: What alerting was added after the April 22, 2026 fraud-scorer feature store incident?
questions.answer: CHG-1080: an alert when the feature store consumer lag is above 2 minutes

questions.question: Who deployed the change that caused the March 12, 2026 outage, and at what time?
questions.answer: Sara Haddad, at 13:55 UTC (CHG-1042)

questions.question: Which runbook covers the failure behind the March 12, 2026 outage, and which metric does it watch?
questions.answer: RB-03, ledger_pool_in_use (above 90%)

questions.question: Who approved the change that caused the April 7, 2026 merchant portal login outage?
questions.answer: Hannah Kim
